verdict.rationale: Token2 publishes integration guides, including automated Entra ID registration and Intune workstation passwordless login, and ships a tool that streamlines registering keys in Microsoft Entra ID. This guidance is enterprise and admin oriented. No evidence shows a setup app or walkthrough that guides an individual user through registering the key with their own accounts, and the evidence shows only guide titles, not their content. Missing for 10: a guided first-run setup wizard in the companion apps, step-by-step registration instructions for common consumer accounts, evidence of the depth of the integration guides' content, and independent or hands-on corroboration of setup ease.

support.subject: As a power user, first-time setup is guided — clear instructions or a setup app walk me through registering the key with my accounts

citations.quote: Automated Registration for Entra ID with PowerShell and GraphAPI
This tool streamlines the process of registering FIDO2 security keys in Microsoft Entra ID by leveraging the FIDO2 Provisioning Graph API.
